lesson.title: Verify Product Availability Before Cart Confirmation
lesson.when: A customer requests to add or update an item in their cart or purchase list, and the item's catalog information or stock status has not been retrieved from tool outputs.
lesson.do: Search the product catalog and verify product details and stock status using relevant system tools before confirming the updated cart or item selection.
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty regarding item availability or selection state without stating unverified items are saved or confirmed.

# Verify Product Availability Before Cart Confirmation

## When
A customer requests to add or update an item in their cart or purchase list, and the item's catalog information or stock status has not been retrieved from tool outputs.

## Do
Search the product catalog and verify product details and stock status using relevant system tools before confirming the updated cart or item selection.

## Otherwise
Express uncertainty regarding item availability or selection state without stating unverified items are saved or confirmed.

# Verify Cart Item Pricing Before Asserting Totals

## When
A customer updates cart items or states a total budget and requests cart verification, but product prices or total amounts have not been retrieved or verified via tools.
